topic_a_inefficiencies.description: urllib.request boilerplate duplicated 15+ times across all 7 method files.
14 bare except Exception clauses across 6 files silently swallow errors.
benchmark_runner.py runs 7 independent methods sequentially instead of parallel.
Every run hits external APIs without caching despite KB-0005 recommending TTL cache.
method_wikidata.py may be missing standard run() entry point.
3 of 6 CLAUDE.md workflow steps are manual index bookkeeping.
No CI/pre-commit hooks. Tests must be manually invoked.
